name: Bond market volatility
summary: MOVE index near 98 and US 10-year yield 4.84%, both at the edge of the Watch lines
state: The MOVE index of Treasury volatility was about 98 on 5 Nov and the US 10-year yield 4.84%, about 39bp lower than a month earlier (Yahoo Finance). Both readings sit just under the Watch lines (MOVE 100, 40bp a month), so Watch is kept until they clearly clear them. October payrolls on 6 Nov are the next test.
for_you: Swings in US yields feed through to mortgage and borrowing costs worldwide, including fixed-rate deals in the UK.
rubric_hit: MOVE 98 and 10y 1m move 39bp at the Watch lines (100, 40bp)
why: US Treasuries price almost every asset on earth; when the 'risk-free' market becomes volatile, funding and collateral chains strain.
drivers: Inflation data, Fed path, deficits and auction demand, foreign holder flows, liquidity.

rubric.alert: MOVE > 140, or disorderly Treasury trading (failed/tailed auctions with Fed action, emergency buybacks).
rubric.watch: MOVE 100–140, or US 10y moved ≥ 40bp in a month, or weak auctions flagged.
rubric.normal: MOVE index < 100 and US 10y moved < 40bp over the past month.
